pattern: ている場合じゃない（ているばあいじゃない）
aliases: ているばあいじゃない
purpose: Say that the present situation calls for something more urgent.
keywords: Verb ている + 場合じゃない / 場合ではない
This is no time to laugh.
This is no time to hesitate. Let us decide now.
This is no time to watch television. The exam is tomorrow.
formation: Verb ている + 場合じゃない / 場合ではない
restrictions: Often rebukes an inappropriate action or redirects one’s own attention.
mistake: It concerns what is appropriate now, not whether the action is physically possible.
